assays.method: Product readout citing ref24; Fig4 reports delta absorbance at248nm per minute. Lineweaver-Burk regression supplies Vmax and KM; kcat derived from Vmax. Raw fits and complete earlier readout method are not retained.
assays.qualification_scope: The paper explicitly applies these conditions to wild type and both mutants. Qualification permits descriptive within-Table1 comparisons, not complete assay reconstruction or transfer to another study.
assays.uncertainty: kcat and KM are means plus/minus TWO standard deviations from five separate determinations. Figure4 points are means of three measurements per substrate concentration; specific-activity footnote a has a separate triplicate scope. None establishes five independent protein preparations.

compilation_relation.question: Can the 1995 reference qualify exact Fried2014 compiled WT/Y16F/D40N rows?
compilation_relation.citation_chain: Fried2014 TableS2 cites refs16/18/19 collectively; reference16 is KimChoi1995. Fried main D40N impairment prose also cites16.
compilation_relation.interpretation: WT and Y16F differ in both central value and printed error, so reference16 is not an exact source for those TableS2 pairs. D40N has identical displayed central value and plus/minus magnitude plus a supporting main-text citation, making it a supported candidate lineage; the compilation does not explicitly identify a per-row source. Preserve its compiled status and unknown error model rather than relabeling it as a fresh measurement.
compilation_relation.prose_factor_scope: Kim1995 reports approximately10^3.3 Y16F impairment and its central-value quotient is about2009. Fried2014 TableS2 quotient is2025; neither exact pair yields its approximately10^4 main-text statement (refs11/16). The source reason for that prose scope remains unresolved.

limitations: Matched named constructs support within-study parameter comparisons even without project-transcribed exact sequences; physical specimen identity and cross-study equivalence are not established.

The kcat and KM declines are endpoint-specific. Lower apparent KM is not an equilibrium Kd measurement or proof of tighter binding. The paper makes a binding interpretation; this packet does not adopt it as established affinity.
Rates are source-reported steady-state parameters, not identified microscopic step constants or proof that residual activity arises from a particular mutant mechanism.

Figure4 triplicates, Table1 kinetic five determinations and specific-activity triplicates have distinct scopes. No propagated ratio error, statistical significance or independent preparation count is inferred.

Kim1995 explicitly maps P. putida Asp40/Tyr16 to C. testosteroni Asp38/Tyr14. Its alignment and similar-mechanism interpretation do not demonstrate solution hydroxide as D40N base, reketonization limitation or identical protein states.

Probe spectroscopy remains a separate Fried2014 experiment using19-nortestosterone sulfate inD2O atpD7.4. No field-only cause, direct transition-state field, productive geometry, new experiment or design-performance claim follows.
